extraction_notes: State name, audit year, and report number from cover page. Fiscal indicators from Executive Summary (Page 11, 12, 23), Chapter 1 (Page 29, 31, 42, 58, 64, 68). Revenue deficit is 0 as the state had a revenue surplus. Outstanding debt is total outstanding liabilities. Audit paras figures are based on "Excess expenditure over appropriations not regularised" from Executive Summary (Page 15, 75) and Appendix 2.1 (Page 133). 'Raised this year' refers to the number of grants with excess expenditure in 2018-19. 'Outstanding over 5 years' and 'PAC recommendations pending' refer to the total number of grants/appropriations with excess expenditure from 2007-08 to 2018-19 that are yet to be regularised.
